task_title: Scrub operator host paths from the public answer corpus + export pipeline + guard
task_criteria: 1) scripts/export-answers.py sanitizes every /home/<user> path prefix (kara, bunker*, runner, user) in description/solution/evidence written to the corpus, mapped to ~ (e.g. /home/kara/.local/bin/pi-agent -> ~/.local/bin/pi-agent), with a runnable self-test under scripts/tests/ proving the mapping. 2) internal/export/git.go answer writer sanitizes the same pattern (community subtree export is a public surface) with a test in internal/export/git_test.go. 3) The committed corpus is scrubbed by REGENERATING via python3 scripts/export-answers.py plus python3 scripts/generate-static-site.py (never hand-editing data/answers/*.json): grep -rE '/home/[a-z0-9_-]+' data/ site/ returns 0 matches, data/COUNTS.md totals unchanged vs git show HEAD:data/COUNTS.md (named deltas only with reason), per-file answers arrays keep their length. 4) A guard scripts/check-corpus-hygiene.sh (make target check-corpus-hygiene, wired into .github/workflows/ci.yml) exits non-zero listing offending files when any /home/<user> path appears under data/ or site/ and 0 on clean; its self-test proves non-vacuity (dirty fixture fails, clean passes). 5) go build ./..., go vet ./..., gofmt -l cmd/ internal/ pkg/ sql/ empty, go test ./... -short -p 1 -count=1 -timeout 120s all pass.
